question: Must this PR demonstrate the exact-head External macOS SSH plus Screen Sharing flow on a real credentialed endpoint before merge, or may maintainers explicitly waive that proof gate?
rationale: The implementation adds a new credential-bearing configuration and runtime surface, while the PR and maintainer discussion acknowledge that its central External-provider flow has not run on an approved real endpoint.

options.title: Require real endpoint proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until redacted evidence shows exact-head authentication, visible desktop access, reset or reconnect, and cleanup on an External macOS endpoint.

options.title: Explicitly waive the gate
options.body: Record acceptance of the synthetic matrix, exact-head CI and Linux run, adjacent Tart proof, and unresolved External endpoint and upgrade risk.

recommendation.title: Require real endpoint proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until redacted evidence shows exact-head authentication, visible desktop access, reset or reconnect, and cleanup on an External macOS endpoint.

likelyOwner.reason: They performed the branch hardening, stated the remaining proof and feature-acceptance gates, and own the recent adjacent macOS WebVNC work.
